summary: The InitValue property sets a default value for new table fields when records are created, initialized, or cleared. This property applies only to new records and cannot be used on standard fields through table extensions.

title: BC Friday Tips #79 Change Log Deletion on One Field
summary: Enabling deletion logging on a single primary key field is sufficient to track who deleted a record in Business Central, avoiding unnecessary duplicate Change Log entries. This approach keeps the change log smaller and easier to review.

title: BC Friday Tips #80 Business Central Trivia
summary: Business Central Trivia is a website where users can test their BC knowledge, earn points, and compete on a leaderboard. It provides an engaging alternative to traditional training materials for consultants, developers, and power users.

title: BC Friday Tips #81 Keep BCContainerHelper Up to Date
summary: BCContainerHelper is a PowerShell module for Business Central container workflows. Keeping it updated ensures you get the latest bug fixes and performance improvements that may resolve container issues.

title: BC Friday Tips #82 Excel Buffer Character Limit
summary: Excel Buffer in Business Central has a 250-character limit on field values. When longer text is written to it, Business Central throws an error instead of silently truncating, which can cause Excel exports to fail.

title: BC Friday Tips #83 Check Whether a Record Has Changed
summary: The Record.IsDirty() method detects whether a record has been modified without requiring manual tracking. This pattern simplifies code when applying multiple field updates to a record.

title: Change Behaviour on VAT Prod. Posting Group - Prices Incl. VAT in v28.2
summary: Business Central v28.2 changed how it handles VAT Product Posting Group changes on G/L Account purchase lines when Prices Incl. VAT is enabled. Previously the total including VAT remained constant, but now the unit cost recalculates and the total amount decreases.

title: BC Tech Days 2026
summary: The post reflects on BC Tech Days 2026, highlighting that AI agents dominated conference discussions and have become central to the Business Central community's focus. It emphasizes the shift from curiosity about AI capabilities to practical adoption questions.

title: How to implement Microsoft BCQuality in your GitHub Pull Request
summary: This post explains how to set up Microsoft BCQuality, a knowledge base for Business Central AL code quality reviews, in a GitHub pull request workflow using an agentic workflow. It provides step-by-step instructions to implement automated code quality checks without blocking merges.

title: Same Blog, New Site
summary: That NAV Guy migrated his blog from WordPress to a static site built with Astro, GitHub, and Vercel. The change improves site performance and simplifies maintenance while preserving all existing content and series.

title: AL Pocket Tools
summary: AL Pocket Tools is a VS Code extension that provides utilities for Dynamics 365 Business Central developers to streamline repetitive development tasks like managing app files, updating versions, and navigating code blocks.

title: SymLynx
summary: SymLynx is a VS Code extension that solves the problem of duplicating configuration files across multiple Business Central repositories by using symbolic links to point to a single master copy, eliminating file synchronization issues and config drift.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Why when I create new users do they get full access by default
summary: New users in Business Central automatically receive full access to their first company based on their assigned license. Administrators can prevent this by modifying permission sets in the License Configuration page.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Handling the message “Only the Posting No. Series can be filled in on recurring journals” in Recurring Journals
summary: Recurring General Journals in Business Central prevent using standard No. Series due to line persistence after posting. The post explains why this restriction exists and demonstrates two techniques: using Posting No. Series on the batch header, or employing placeholders in the Document No. field to automatically generate unique document numbers based on posting dates without manual updates.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Why isn’t Payment Tolerance being taken automatically in the Cash Receipt Journal?
summary: Payment Tolerance is a Business Central feature that automatically writes off small unpaid invoice balances, but it only works when cash receipts are entered with the Payment document type selected. The post explains common setup mistakes that prevent this functionality from triggering.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – How to proportionally split costs across Dimensions using Statistical Accounts and Allocation Accounts
summary: This post explains how to automatically split costs across cost center dimensions in Business Central using Statistical Accounts and Allocation Accounts. It demonstrates a scenario where heating expenses are distributed proportionally to departments based on square footage, streamlining accurate cost allocation without manual intervention.

title: Dynamics 365 Business Central – Some Considerations when Changing Standard Cost on an Item Card
summary: Changing standard cost directly on an item card in Business Central has two critical side effects: stock keeping units are not automatically updated, and existing inventory is not revalued. Understanding these considerations is essential before making cost changes to avoid unexpected cost adjustments during sales transactions.

title: Earning the MVP Title, One Year at a Time
summary: A community contributor reflects on earning Microsoft MVP status again after a one-year gap, emphasizing that the title requires continuous engagement, contribution, and growth rather than being a lifetime achievement. The post explores how stepping out of the program temporarily became motivating rather than discouraging.

title: Introducing AL Table Visualizer: An Interactive ER Diagram for Your Business Central Tables
summary: AL Table Visualizer is a Visual Studio Code extension that generates interactive ER diagrams from Business Central table definitions and compiled symbol packages, helping developers understand data model relationships through visualization rather than manual code tracing.

title: Business Central Analytics: The Technology Is Not the Hard Part
summary: Business Central analytics tools like Power BI, Data Analysis mode, and APIs enable dashboards and insights, but adoption success depends more on helping users ask better business questions than on technology maturity.

title: Where GitHub Copilot Actually Saves Time in AL Projects
summary: GitHub Copilot saves time in AL development through deliberate use of Chat, Agent, Ask, and Edit modes for specific tasks. Agent mode generates boilerplate and test scaffolding efficiently, Chat mode helps explore unfamiliar APIs, Ask mode explains existing code, and Edit mode refactors with precision, though all generated code requires developer review before acceptance.

title: API Pages vs API Queries in Business Central: When to Use Each
summary: API pages and API queries are two distinct REST API object types in Business Central with different purposes. API pages support full CRUD operations and are best for write operations, while API queries are optimized for read-only access with multi-table joins and server-side aggregation. Understanding when to use each type is critical for performance and integration design.

title: Business Central 2026 Release Wave 1: A Mix of Platform Evolution and Practical Improvements
summary: Business Central version 28 (April 2026) delivers distributed improvements across supply chain, reporting, governance, and developer tooling rather than single headline features. The release addresses daily friction points in inventory, purchasing, manufacturing, and introduces agent-driven administration infrastructure and semantic search capabilities.

title: How Do I: Use the Word Add-in for Business Central Report Layouts
summary: The Dynamics 365 Business Central Word add-in is a free Microsoft Word extension that simplifies designing Word layouts for document reports by enabling easy field insertion, layout comments, and conditional content hiding based on data values. The add-in requires Business Central version 25 or later, with full data picker functionality in version 27 and later.

title: Which Power BI License Do You Need for Business Central?
summary: Power BI Pro is required for any practical use of Power BI with Business Central, including viewing embedded reports, installing Microsoft Power BI Apps, and sharing reports. The free license only provides a personal workspace with limited refresh capacity and no sharing capabilities.

title: Quick Tip: Business Central Launch Edition 2026 Wave 1: 37 Sessions
summary: The Business Central Launch Edition for 2026 Wave 1 provides 37 free video sessions covering the latest features across Copilot and AI, reporting, supply chain, finance, development, Shopify integration, and administration released on April 1, 2026.

title: Quick Tip: BC28: What Is New in Document Reporting
summary: BC28 introduces enhanced document reporting features including an improved Word add-in with a redesigned data picker, a new table builder for layouts, lifecycle status management for user-defined layouts, company-level default document language, tooltips on reports, modernized report selection pages, and 36 new document APIs covering sales, purchasing, inventory, and assembly document types.

title: Quick Tip: CalcFields vs SetAutoCalcFields in AL
summary: FlowFields in Business Central are not stored in the database and must be calculated explicitly. The post explains two methods for calculating them: CalcFields for one-time calculations on single records, and SetAutoCalcFields for automatic calculation during record retrieval, with guidance on which to use to avoid performance issues.

title: How Do I: Choose the Right AI Assistant for AL Development?
summary: When choosing an AI assistant for AL development, GitHub Copilot in VS Code excels for code generation with codebase context, while Claude.ai or Claude desktop offer better value for reasoning-heavy tasks like architecture and error analysis due to frontier model access without Copilot cost multipliers. The decision depends on the task type and the new usage-based billing model effective June 2026.

title: Quick Tip: GitHub Copilot Billing: Setting the Record Straight
summary: GitHub Copilot billing changes from request-based to usage-based pricing on June 1, 2026, affecting how sub-agent costs are calculated. Under the new model, each sub-agent's token consumption is billed individually rather than at the highest multiplier rate, making model selection for individual agents financially significant.

title: How Do I: Manage and Postpone BC Updates in the Admin Center
summary: Managing Business Central SaaS updates in the Admin Center allows you to schedule, delay, and respond to rollout pauses. This matters because environments upgraded to a problematic version cannot be rolled back, while postponement controls and notification setup help you avoid becoming the test cohort for production issues.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central Update 28.1
summary: Business Central Update 28.1 introduces the Expense Agent in public preview, a new Expense Management module for submitting and processing receipts, and expands Agent Designer to production environments. Additional features reaching general availability include excise tax calculation, report layout lifecycle control, and various fixes for deferrals, inventory posting, and localization.

title: Quick Tip: Almost Every BC Major Release Gets Paused. Are Your Environments Ready?
summary: Business Central major release rollouts get paused frequently due to discovered issues, and this is normal process design since 2020. Environments already upgraded before a pause cannot be rolled back, but those not yet upgraded get rescheduled safely. Partners should schedule production updates late in the window, configure notification recipients, and test in sandboxes to manage the risk effectively.

title: Quick Tip: How Can You Download the Standard Business Central Power BI Reports?
summary: Business Central standard Power BI reports are now distributed through official Power BI template apps rather than the old GitHub repository. Users can install apps for Finance, Sales, Purchasing, Inventory, Manufacturing, Projects, Sustainability and others, then download PBIX files from Power BI workspaces, subject to permissions and licensing requirements.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central Update 28.2
summary: Business Central Update 28.2 (June 2026) introduces meaningful feature enhancements alongside hotfixes, including improvements to the Sales Order Agent for multilingual support, Quality Management reports with Word layouts as default, financial features like withholding tax and self-billed invoices, new Reporting and Data Analysis APIs, country-specific capabilities for payments and electronic invoicing, and sustainability APIs for data exchange.

title: Quick Tip: Troubleshooting Business Central Power BI Reports: My 5-Minute Checklist
summary: Most Business Central Power BI issues stem from configuration problems rather than Power BI itself. The post provides a systematic 5-step troubleshooting checklist covering environment connectivity, data source verification, access permissions, refresh timing, and only then investigating actual Power BI problems.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central Update 28.3
summary: Business Central 28.3 introduces Sales Order Agent to General Availability with multi-agent support and improved item matching, enables free Payables Agent trials with 50 invoice processing, enhances Expense Agent with language support and project assignment, and allows PTE management from the Admin Center.

title: Quick Tip: Runtime Version and Business Central Version Are Not the Same Thing
summary: Runtime version in app.json determines which AL language features are available and controls compatibility with platform versions. Developers often confuse runtime version with platform (internal) version or release wave name, but only runtime version matters for code compilation and customer system requirements.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central Update 28.4
summary: Update 28.4 for Business Central 2026 Release Wave 1 was released on August 3, 2026, bringing three new features to general availability or preview: Payables Agent known senders to skip redundant email classification, payments integration with the electronic document framework, and Peppol preview on purchase drafts. The update is mostly hotfixes across platform, application, and country-specific areas.

title: Quick Tip: Reading the Capacity Page in the Business Central Admin Center
summary: The Capacity page in Business Central Admin Center shows database storage usage and environment counts against your limits. Understanding the two separate limits (environment count and storage quota) helps prevent creation failures without needing support.

title: Quick Tip: It’s Time to Move to the Word Add-in Data Picker
summary: The classic XML Mapping pane for Word report layouts in Business Central has started rejecting newly inserted fields as of August 2026, though existing mapped fields remain functional. Microsoft recommends switching to the newer Word add-in data picker, available since Business Central 2025 wave 2, which offers a more modern interface and avoids legacy XML mapping issues.

title: Quick Tip: You Can Now Create a Business Central 29.0 (Preview) Sandbox
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (version 29.0) is now available as a preview sandbox from the admin center until early October 2026. Preview sandboxes are automatically deleted 30 days after general availability and cannot be migrated to other versions, so they serve primarily as testing windows before upgrade projects begin.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central 2026 Release Wave 2, Update 29.0 Preview
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 (update 29.0) introduces a unified Copilot chat experience, new data model for table extensions, composable report layouts, withholding tax for vendors, subcontracting improvements, Shopify B2B support, and sustainability tracking enhancements. This preview is live for evaluation before October 2026 general availability.

title: BCQuality: A Shared Quality Bar for AL Code, Built for Agents
summary: BCQuality is Microsoft's open repository of quality knowledge for AL code designed to guide both human developers and AI agents toward shared coding standards. It organizes domain-specific rules in markdown files filtered by BC version and functional area, with a three-layer architecture where partners can add custom knowledge that applies automatically during code review.

title: Quick Tip: GitHub Copilot Chat Modes Are Now Agents, and Edit Mode Is Gone
summary: GitHub Copilot Chat modes have been reorganized into agent roles in VS Code. The Edit mode has been replaced by diff-based editing within Agent, Plan is now a built-in role, and custom chat modes are now custom agents with a new file extension and configuration interface.

title: Plan, Custom Agents, and Session Target: What Actually Changed in Copilot Chat
summary: VS Code reorganised Copilot Chat by converting modes to agent roles, promoting Plan from preview to a built-in role alongside Agent and Ask. The new Session Target control lets you choose which harness runs your session (Local, Copilot, Claude, Codex, or Cloud), separate from model choice. Custom chat modes now use .agent.md files with configurable tool access and instructions per agent.

title: Choosing a Language Model for AL Development in VS Code
summary: When using Copilot Chat in VS Code for AL development, you can select different language models based on task complexity. Fast models suit simple tasks while reasoning models handle design decisions, but AL developers must validate model suggestions against actual BC symbols since models may confidently produce outdated code based on old training data.

title: Quick Tip: What’s in Business Central Update 28.5?
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 1, update 28.5 introduces two main features: Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI resources for Copilot extensions (now generally available) and embedded Verifactu mode for Spanish tax reporting. This smaller monthly update simplifies Copilot deployment by removing the need for customers to manage their own Azure OpenAI infrastructure.

title: Quick Tip: Business Central Release Plans Are Going Away. Where Do You Look Now?
summary: Microsoft is retiring the Dynamics 365 Release Plans and moving Business Central roadmap information to the AI at Work roadmap, starting September 2026. Business Central's release cadence remains unchanged with two major releases per year, but future capabilities will be disclosed continuously rather than grouped into release waves.

title: Quick Tip: Business Central 29.0 Is Now Generally Available
summary: Business Central version 29.0 (2026 release wave 2) is now generally available. The release includes substantial improvements across Copilot and agents, AL development, reporting and analytics, financial management, supply chain, electronic documents, and sustainability, with dedicated What's New sessions organized by topic area.

title: Business Central Data Mirroring to Microsoft Fabric Is Coming
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, a new analytical data path that synchronizes selected tables and companies to Fabric's OneLake for analytics consumption. This simplifies analytics architecture by eliminating the need to repeatedly extract transactional data through APIs, making it easier to build enterprise data platforms combining Business Central with other sources.

title: Business Central 29: Introducing Composite Document Layouts
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 introduces Composite Document Layouts, a modular approach to Word document layouts that separates body content, visual theming, and headers/footers into reusable components combined at runtime rather than maintaining separate complete layouts for each combination.

title: Distributing Agents with Plugins
summary: Distribution of custom agents to teams is accomplished through plugins, which package agents, skills, and MCP configurations in a shared repository that team members can install with one click in GitHub Copilot or Claude Code. The post explains how to set up marketplace and plugin manifests to enable seamless sharing across ecosystems without manual file copying.

title: Claude Code: Tiny Tips
summary: Claude Code is an AI development tool with several lesser-known terminal commands and VS Code integration tips that improve workflow efficiency. The post covers keyboard shortcuts, agent porting considerations, and advanced features like model switching and advisor mode for developers migrating from Copilot or optimizing their Claude Code usage.

title: Copilot is just a fancy autocomplete (vol.3) - Steps towards agentic development
summary: This post explains five progressive steps toward agentic development: custom agents tailored to specific workflows, skills for reusable task sequences, reflection loops to improve agent instructions, sub-agents for parallel research with isolated context windows, and background agents running in terminals or pipelines without direct supervision.

title: Copilot is agent-first, Claude Code is skill-first
summary: Copilot uses an agent-first architecture where you select a persona before interacting, while Claude Code is skill-first with a single agent throughout a session. Understanding this difference is crucial when migrating custom agents between platforms, as agents that step into conversations in Copilot map to skills in Claude Code, while those that fork and report map to subagents.

title: Context is a voting chamber
summary: Long agent sessions balance cost efficiency through prompt caching with attention degradation, where context acts as a voting chamber where older information dilutes focus on current objectives. Understanding when to start fresh sessions or use handoffs versus maintaining warm caches determines productivity and actual token costs.

title: ALCops: The Next Chapter of LinterCop
summary: ALCops is a new community-driven code analyzer collection for AL that succeeds LinterCop, with about 95% of the original rules migrated. It provides VS Code extension and AL-Go support for daily AL development, with future work on Azure DevOps integration and AI tool compatibility.

title: ALCops: The Story So Far
summary: ALCops is a community-driven collection of code analyzers for AL that reached v1.0 after six months of development with over 480 merged pull requests. It provides focused specialized analyzers for language correctness, code smells, formatting, documentation, and testing, now integrated with AI assistants through an MCP server and replacing the earlier LinterCop project by October 2026.

title: Dutch Dynamics Community Event 10 February 2026
summary: A Dutch Dynamics Community event on February 10, 2026 featured technical sessions on creating AI agents inside Business Central (released in version 27.4) and using Copilot for AI pair programming in AL development. The post emphasizes how agents work within the existing Business Central environment and the importance of effective prompts for better AI assistance.

title: Troubleshooting Series – Ep2 – Admin Center – Sessions
summary: The Sessions window in the Business Central Admin Center allows partners and delegated admins to view active sessions across all server instances and cancel problematic ones to improve system performance and resolve resource issues.

title: Handling Business Central Telemetry like a boss: iFacto Telemetry – Pt. 3
summary: The iFacto Telemetry app extends Business Central's built-in telemetry capabilities by adding custom events to track missing indexes, function performance, media orphans, installed apps, delegated user actions, feature management status, and retention policies. It helps administrators monitor system health and performance across multiple customers and environments.

title: Obsoleted and “no longer invoked” events in v26 Business Central
summary: Business Central v26 removed invocation of 82 obsoleted events from the legacy invoice posting system while keeping them in the codebase for backward compatibility. Code subscribing to these non-invoked events will compile and publish but fail silently at runtime, creating a hidden risk for developers upgrading from earlier versions.

title: BCTalent – Escape Rooms
summary: The BCTalent program created Business Central escape rooms where trainees complete consultant or developer tasks within BC to unlock progression. The framework-based app tracks progress via events and telemetry, with potential for future use by ISVs and at industry events.

title: Troubleshooting Series – Ep3 – Missing Indexes
summary: Troubleshooting missing indexes in Business Central SaaS environments requires understanding the Missing Indexes page, which reflects SQL DMV data that resets after server restart. Since developers can only add indexes through apps, careful analysis using telemetry to track missing indexes over time helps identify which indexes are truly necessary before implementation.

title: Troubleshooting Series – Ep4 – Event Recorder
summary: The Event Recorder is a Business Central troubleshooting tool that captures all events during a specific process by starting and stopping recording. It helps developers and troubleshooters identify performance issues, validate functional behavior, debug customizations, understand extension behavior, and document system processes.

title: Analyzing BC Telemetry with AI with the “BC Telemetry Buddy”
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy is a VSCode extension and Model Context Protocol tool that lets users query Business Central telemetry data through natural conversation using GitHub Copilot, without needing to write KQL or have separate subscriptions. It includes features for event discovery, stack trace analysis, report generation, and custom chat modes for focused analysis workflows.

title: BC Telemetry Buddy – 84 commits later..
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy evolved from a proof of concept to a production-ready tool for analyzing Business Central telemetry. The v1.0.0 release transformed it from a bundled extension into modular components, added AI-powered chat features for data discovery and analysis, and implemented comprehensive testing and CI/CD pipelines.

title: BC Telemetry Buddy  – When Your 12-Year-Old Accidentally Helps You Find a Problem
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy is an AI-powered tool that lets you ask natural language questions about Business Central telemetry data instead of writing complex KQL queries. It helped uncover a critical performance issue where a background job was wasting 67.7 hours daily through inefficient queries and missing retention policies, diagnosed in 15 minutes and fixed by adding indexes and enabling retention.

title: Escape Room App gone public!
summary: The BCTalent Escape Room framework, a tool for building interactive learning experiences in Business Central, has been released as open source. It provides a documented platform for creating custom rooms and puzzles for training, onboarding, and feature adoption rather than complete puzzle content.

title: Troubleshooting Series – Ep5 – Telemetry
summary: Telemetry is essential for troubleshooting Business Central SaaS because it provides evidence about when issues occur, their frequency, affected customers, and performance metrics without SQL access or profilers. The post covers two telemetry channels (environment-level and app/extension-level), Microsoft-provided tools like Power BI apps and Azure Data Explorer, and the BC Telemetry Buddy tool that makes querying telemetry easier through AI assistance.

title: I built the tool .. but forgot the skill..
summary: Building effective AI tools for telemetry analysis requires more than access to data and dashboards. The quality of questions asked and critical evaluation of AI responses are the real limiting factors in diagnosing performance issues.

title: BC Telemetry Buddy .. now with (community) knowledge
summary: BC Telemetry Buddy now includes a two-layer knowledge base that shares telemetry troubleshooting patterns and investigation playbooks across the community. The tool stores both shared community knowledge and local customer-specific insights as markdown files, allowing the AI to start problem-solving with context rather than from scratch.

title: OptimAL – performance still matters
summary: OptimAL is a structured Microsoft performance initiative for BC partners and ISVs that combines maturity assessment, skills training, telemetry analysis, and hands-on code optimization. The program addresses how most BC performance issues stem from partner code rather than the platform, with participants achieving dramatic improvements like reducing batch job runtime from 5+ hours to under 20 minutes or improving page load times by 93%.

title: “the waldo way”
summary: A CTO reflects on building a pre-packaged agentic development harness for the team to accelerate adoption, but questions whether removing setup friction also eliminates valuable learning opportunities. The post explores the tradeoff between speed-and-consistency versus developer ownership and skill-building.

title: Business Central data in Fabric: the way it should be
summary: Business Central now supports native data mirroring to Microsoft Fabric, allowing users to replicate their tables as Delta Parquet files in OneLake with SQL query access. The feature enters public preview in release wave 2 (likely version 29.1) and requires only workspace setup and table selection with no impact on BC performance or API limits.

title: The Business Central 2026 release wave 2 docs nobody asked for ..
summary: Waldo created an interactive navigation tool for the Business Central 2026 Wave 2 release event videos, mapping 319 features across 38 videos with direct timestamps to help users find specific announcements without watching all 7+ hours. The site uses AI to extract features and quotes from auto-captions and cross-references them with official documentation to highlight gaps or conflicts.

title: What's New: Sales Lines Suggestions with Copilot (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Sales line suggestions with Copilot in Business Central, as covered in the 2024 release wave 1 What's New video. Covers better keyword extraction and context understanding, faster product search, blanket order linking, document-specific search, units of measure, and CSV upload with column mapping and caching.

title: What's New: Demo Data for Analytics (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 2 adds an analytics demo data package to the Contoso demo data tool, with more sales and purchasing documents and more variation for reporting and Power BI demos. It is optional and must be selected when creating a company.

title: Upgrade Business Central Sandbox to Preview Version
summary: Updating an existing Business Central sandbox to a preview version from the admin center, so upcoming functionality can be tested with real customer data, configurations and extensions. Covers scheduling the update, post-upgrade testing and preview limitations, including deletion 30 days after GA.

title: What's New: User Experience Enhancements (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 2 user experience changes: factbox resizing, Advanced Tellme semantic search (preview), extra instructions for the sales order agent, week numbers in date pickers, and a data masking property for sensitive fields (preview).

title: Business Central Launch Event 2025 Release Wave 1 - Recording of Live Opening
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 1 launch event recording (published 2025-04-11): covers the sales order agent in public preview, agent billing by messages, a payables agent demo in private preview, Copilot autofill and summarize, sustainability, e-documents, manufacturing, Power BI, admin, developer and performance changes.

title: Introducing: PTEs in Admin Center (2025 release wave 1)
summary: PTEs in the Business Central admin center (2025 release wave 1): the admin center now lists PTEs and dev extensions next to global apps, lets admins uninstall apps and see dependencies, and exposes the same data in admin center API version 2.25.

title: Work Seamlessly with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Teams
summary: Business Central used with Microsoft Teams, Outlook, Excel and Word in a scripted customer-service and sales scenario. It shows Teams chat links and tabs, read-only access via a Microsoft 365 account, a Power Automate escalation, Outlook contact insights and quotes, and Excel/Word editing.

title: Introducing: Sustainability in Business Central (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Sustainability in Business Central (2024 release wave 1) covers the foundational module for recording and reporting greenhouse gas emissions: setup, chart of sustainability accounts, journals, ledger entries, three standard reports and demo data. Regulatory reports and APIs are not part of this wave.

title: Concurrency in Business Central: Parallel processes without deadlocks and timeouts
summary: Business Central concurrency session covering SQL Server lock types, isolation levels, lock escalation at about 5,000 locks, and deadlocks, with demos of loops, chunking, SEMAPHORE locks, number sequences and auto increment in a cinema booking case. Lock timeout defaults are 10 seconds on-premise and 35 seconds in SaaS.

title: What's New: Business Central Integration with Dataverse (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Business Central integration with Dataverse in 2024 release wave 1: data sync changes (linked environments, table and field mappings on existing integration tables, troubleshooting fact box), synthetic relationships, multi-company virtual tables with mapping plugins, and business event monitoring with Application Insights.

title: Introducing Payment Times Analysis in Business Central (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Payment Times Analysis in Business Central (2023 release wave 2) analyzes whether vendor and customer payments happen on or after due dates. It can aggregate by company size or by custom period, and the video demos both, including drill-down, history and printing.

title: Transfer Environments
summary: Transferring Business Central environments between Microsoft Entra tenants through the tenant admin center: how to start a transfer in the source tenant, cancel pending ones, accept in the destination tenant, and the requirements (permissions, license, quota, timing limits).

title: Business Central 29: New ModuleInfo Properties Explained
summary: ModuleInfo in Business Central 29 (Runtime 18.0 or later) gets four new properties: help, ULA, privacy statement and context sensitive help URL. They expose app manifest metadata to AL code. The video demos reading them with NavApp.GetCurrentModuleInfo and NavApp.GetModuleInfo, and compares this with version 28.

title: Introducing: Composite Document Layouts (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Composite document layouts in Business Central (2026 release wave 2): report layouts split into a body layout, themes and header-footer layouts that are applied at runtime. Covers layered defaults, custom themes, shipped themes in 20.9, and rollout through feature management and layout status.

title: What's New: Migrate Record Links and Notes (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Migrating record links and notes from an on-premises database to Business Central online as part of cloud migration (2025 release wave 2). Covers the buffer table, the Migrate record links and notes action on the cloud migration management page, the warnings field, and the required order: replication, then migration, then user mapping.

title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 4: How we built Copilot Chat in Business Central
summary: Copilot Chat in Business Central: how Microsoft built it, covering architecture, intent condensation, data grounding, meta prompts, jailbreak prevention, and test-driven prompt engineering. Copilot Chat is in public preview and available only in US environments, per the video.

title: What's new in E-Documents: Overview (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Overview of EDI in Business Central's e-documents framework (2026 release wave 2): purchase order, sales order, order response and remittance advice exchange in XML, with a demo and three new French e-reporting formats. Feature status is not stated in the video.

title: Microsoft Sizzle: Business Central Agents In Action
summary: Business Central Sales Order Agent and Payables Agent shown in a 2-minute Microsoft sizzle video, published 2026-02-02. It describes what each agent automates and says users can build their own custom agents. It is a high-level overview, not a how-to.

title: What's New: Analyze Performance Issues with Scheduled Profiles (2024 release wave 2)
summary: Scheduled profiles in Business Central (2024 release wave 2) capture performance profiles automatically in the background based on rules, including for web service calls. The video demos setting up a profile schedule and analyzing the captured results, and contrasts this with the interactive in-client profiler.

title: What's New: Enhanced MCP Server (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Business Central MCP server enhancements in 2026 release wave 1: configuration validation, import/export, connection string setup, telemetry and auditing, MCP resources and embedded resources. Support for MCP hosts other than Copilot Studio, such as VS Code, is in public preview.

title: What's New: Reservation Worksheet and Fulfillment Suggestions (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Reservation Worksheet and the Reserved from Stock indicator in Business Central (2023 release wave 2): how to see reservation status on demand documents, allocate stock with allocation policies, and push fully reserved documents to warehouse shipments, inventory picks and consumption journals.

title: 20260126 - Excel Report Layouts: From Basics to Refreshable, Real-Time Reporting
summary: Excel report layouts in Business Central: a four-step process (get workbook with data contract, lay out data, import, test) and refreshable reports that use OData, Power Query and APIs. Covers data contract rules, hidden metadata sheets, OneDrive setup, permissions and password limits.

title: Sales Order Agent - Working with a Personal or Shared Folder (2026)
summary: Sales order agent in Business Central can be pointed at a specific Outlook folder instead of the inbox, which lets you test with a personal account and only selected emails. The 2-minute video shows folder setup, agent configuration, stopping pending tasks, and switching back to a shared mailbox.

title: What's New: Working with Instructions for Agents in Business Central
summary: Writing instructions for Business Central agents: role-based prompting, a guidelines section, and short process steps. Shown with an Accounts Receivable agent that handles a sales return, reads documents through Azure Document Intelligence, creates a credit memo and drafts an email. Also covers agent memory, user interaction tools and page-specific instructions.

title: #BCTalent Stories: SOCITAS
summary: SOCITAS, a Microsoft partner, describes hiring six people (three consultants, three developers) through the Business Central talent program. It is partner testimony on recruitment and team growth, with brief remarks on Business Central speed and API use with AI models.

title: Introducing Spreadsheets for Business Central
summary: Spreadsheets for Business Central, a spreadsheet app running inside Business Central, is demoed with regions that connect BC data (tables, charts, queries, pages), virtual fields, permissions for sharing and editing, and an AI agent that generates SQL queries and regions.

title: Working with Amount Fields
summary: Working with amount fields in Business Central: by default one amount field takes debit and credit using a sign. The Show Amounts setting on General Ledger Setup switches to separate debit and credit fields. The change applies company-wide.

title: Microsoft presents: Index management
summary: Business Central index management: a page for enabling and disabling table indexes, per-company control, index usage, size and fragmentation statistics, and how the DAMS maintenance service rebuilds indexes and creates tuning-advisor indexes. Also covers extension fields merging into base tables in version 29 (early access preview).

title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 12: Evolving AL for Performance
summary: AL runtime performance work in Business Central, explained by an AL runtime engineer: data transfer, set load fields, read isolation, tri-state locking, and the real behavior of lock table and set current key. Also covers early ideas for dynamic queries and bulk events.

title: What's New: Default Sustainability Information (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Default sustainability values in Business Central (2025 release wave 1): an optional setting in sustainability setup, off by default, adds default sustainability account and emission fields to GL accounts, items, resources and machine centers. Those defaults carry over to purchase document lines and can be edited there.

title: What's New: The Danish Bookkeeping Act (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Danish Bookkeeping Act support in Business Central (2023 release wave 2): mandatory digital vouchers, SAF-T module with chart of accounts mapping, NemHandle notification, e-invoicing, five-year voucher storage and audit trail. Most features are announced, with some still work in progress at publication.

title: Manage all your Apps And Updates in Admin Center for Business Central
summary: Business Central Admin Center app management walkthrough: the all apps view with update actions, dependency-driven "action required" status, scheduling and force sync options, dev apps and PTE filtering, installing and uninstalling apps, and monitoring installs on the Operations page.

title: GP Assessment Tool - Optimize Your Migration to Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)
summary: GP Assessment Tool is a free online tool that reads GP SQL Server data to guide migration planning from Dynamics GP to Business Central. The 3-minute video covers signup, download, running the assessment, sending results, and reading the report with ISV drill-down and migration risks.

title: Business Central Launch Event 2024 Release Wave 2 - Recording of Live Opening
summary: Business Central 2024 release wave 2 launch event opening (recorded 2024-10-09): an overview of Copilot, finance, subscription billing, sustainability, Power Platform, search, admin, developer, AI-building and performance changes in that release.

title: BCTalent Stories: Rui from Acadon
summary: BCTalent Stories episode in which Rui, a consultant at Acadon, describes his path into Business Central consulting, the Microsoft Thailand program membership he received through Acadon, and his support from the team. It is a short career testimonial, not a product feature demo.

title: What's new in reporting: Layout Management and Report Inbox API's (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2026 release wave 2 reporting: administrators can set layout status (draft, pending approval, approved, retired) on report layouts, including app-supplied and Microsoft layouts, and new report inbox APIs let agents and automation work with scheduled reports and report packs.

title: BCTalent Stories: Carcyn & Olivia from Clients First
summary: BCTalent Stories episode with Carcyn and Olivia from Clients First on becoming Business Central consultants. Covers their motivation, the talent program, self-paced training modules, onboarding at their own pace, and improved work-life balance after a career change.

title: What's New: Server and Database (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Server and database changes in Business Central 2026 release wave 1: MCP server protocol compliance and resources, lower per-tenant memory and base64 handling, index usage insights, analysis views in AL apps, document report layout lifecycle, hardened HTTP client URI validation, and new telemetry.

title: Getting Started With Agents: Set Up Sales Order Agent - New 'Try it out' experience (2026)
summary: Sales Order Agent setup in Business Central using the new "Try it out" experience, which creates test tasks without connecting a real inbox. Also covers connecting a personal or shared Outlook inbox, review settings, and how the agent handles a customer email with attachments and a sales quote.

title: What's New: Chat with Copilot (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Chat with Copilot in Business Central (2025 release wave 1) is shown as a natural language chat for finding records, querying inventory, generating analysis tabs and learning features. The video covers citations, the Copilot permission set introduced in update 26, admin setup on the Copilot and Agent Capabilities page, and the prompt guide.

title: Store Files Outside Business Central Using External File Accounts (BC 2025 Wave 1)
summary: External file storage in Business Central 2025 Wave 1: how to install the external file storage extensions, connect Azure Blob Service containers and Azure File Service file shares through external file accounts using shared keys, and browse files in the Storage Browser.

title: Use Teaching Tips to Educate and Guide Users
summary: Teaching tips in Business Central: how to write them for users on a page, and how they relate to documentation and tours. Guidance covers keeping tips brief, limiting them to the three most important things, and that page order sets their sequence.

title: Modern Action Bar
summary: Action bar changes in Business Central 2024 release wave one: a smaller analysis mode icon, removed search and analysis mode captions, Copilot on the action bar for list pages, the process tab renamed home, and split buttons for popular actions.

title: What's New: Shopify Connector B2B Functionality (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Shopify Connector for Business Central in 2024 release wave 1: B2B company and catalog synchronization, B2B checkout, B2B vs D2C order handling, and order editing with refunds and credit memos. Also covers smaller connector changes such as automatic Shopify URL setup, inventory minus reservation, and shipment confirmation control.

title: What's New: Exporting and Importing Agent in Business Central
summary: Exporting and importing agent definitions in Business Central as XML files, from the agent card or agent list. Covers the import wizard with preview, validation warnings, replace-or-create choice, and activation after import. Useful for backing up agents and sharing them across environments.

title: Why Onboarding Experiences are Important
summary: Business Central onboarding strategy for partners: why self-service, templating and packaged partner knowledge matter for scaling. It is a clip from a 2023 release wave 2 launch event video, and the speaker says it is equally relevant today. Feature status is not stated.

title: What's new: Manage PTEs in the Admin Center (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Managing per-tenant extensions (PTEs) in the Business Central admin center in 2026 release wave 2: upload, install, update, scheduling, cancel, audit page, early hotfix install for Microsoft apps, and dev extension persistence on sandboxes. Covers deprecation of the old extension management pages and automation API as of version 30.0 (April 2027).

title: What's New: Upgrade to Preview (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Upgrading a sandbox to the preview version (27.0) of the 2025 release wave 2 in the Business Central admin center. It covers copying production data into a sandbox, selecting the preview target version, scheduling the update, and how failed updates and the end of the preview period are handled.

title: Comparing Subaccount Segments and Dimension Setup between Dynamics SL and Dynamics 365 Business
summary: Subaccount segments in Dynamics SL compared with dimensions in Business Central after migration. Covers the SL flex key (up to eight segments), choosing global dimensions in the SL company migration configuration tool, two global dimensions plus shortcut dimensions, and analysis on the chart of accounts.

title: MCP Server and API Queries (2026 release wave 1)
summary: API queries in the Business Central MCP server, demoed in the 2026 release wave 1 video. Analytics API queries, the foundation of the Power BI apps, can be selected as object type "query" in the MCP server configuration so external agents can use aggregations and analytics. Marked generally available; APIs need version 22.28.2 or later.

title: How to Use Posting Groups in Business Central (2025)
summary: Posting groups in Business Central link customers, vendors and items to general ledger accounts. The 2025 video covers general, subledger-specific and VAT posting groups, VAT posting setup, a sales invoice demo with posting preview, and direct posting to GL accounts.

title: What's New: Smarter Pipelines (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 2 pipeline improvements for repos with many AL projects: the directory.app.props.json file for centralizing app.json settings, and installing the AL command line tool as a dotnet tool. Both were demoed and the dotnet tool is currently pre-release.

title: What's New: Sales Order Agent Enhancements (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Sales order agent enhancements in Business Central (2025 release wave 2), demonstrated in a 21-minute video: attachment analysis (PDF and images), custom instructions, custom email signature, autonomy levels per sender type, capable to promise dates, and direct sales order creation without a quote.

title: Simplify Bank Reconciliation with Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central (2024)
summary: Copilot for bank reconciliation in Dynamics 365 Business Central, shown in a one-minute 2024 demo. Copilot matches bank statement lines to ledger entries, including consolidated charges, suggests GL accounts for unmatched lines, and saves patterns for recurring payments.

title: What's new in Expense Agent: Mobile App ( Preview) (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Expense Agent mobile app, in preview (2026 release wave 2): receipt scanning with auto capture, bulk upload, gallery share, mileage expenses, offline queuing, and submission and approval on a phone. The demo shows the mobile app offering the same agent workflow as the web app.

title: Expense Agent: Finance Controlling (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Expense Agent walkthrough in Business Central: how an employee's expense flows through dimensions, expense report, posting (project and employee ledger entries), employee payment via the payment journal, and project billable costs. Status of the feature is not stated in the facts.

title: Use Retention Policies to Avoid Unnecessary Database Growth
summary: Retention policies in Business Central let administrators trim activity logging and archiving tables to avoid unnecessary database growth. The video demos enabling a default policy on the job queue log entry table and using filters to set different retention periods for failed and successful entries.

title: Microsoft Copilot in Business Central
summary: Microsoft Copilot in Dynamics 365 Business Central, shown as an everyday AI companion in a one-minute overview from May 2024. It covers marketing suggestions, sales quotes, orders and invoices, Power Automate flows, and finance tasks such as bank reconciliation and e-invoice matching.

title: Comparing Posting Accounts and Posting Groups Between Dynamics GP and Dynamics Business Central
summary: Posting accounts in Dynamics GP compared with posting groups in Business Central, for people moving from GP. Covers business, product, customer and inventory posting groups, posting setup, and posting preview of GL accounts.

title: Using the Spotlight Tour Element in Onboarding
summary: Spotlight tour element in Business Central onboarding: a two-step pattern that introduces a page and points to an action, so users can try Teams and Excel features. Developers choose which pages use it. Clip from the 2023 release wave 2 launch event.

title: What's New: Run Page Scripts in CICD Pipelines (2024 release wave 2)
summary: Page script replayer for CI/CD pipelines in Business Central (2024 release wave 2): a standalone replayer distributed as an NPM package that runs recorded page scripts in pipelines for regression testing. AL-Go for GitHub support is announced for the near future; ALOps and Alpaca support are also planned.

title: What's new: Shopify Tax Matching (preview) (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Shopify Tax Matching in the Business Central Shopify connector, an AI capability for US sales tax that matches or creates tax jurisdictions, tax areas and tax details from Shopify orders. The video is a 2026 release wave 2 preview session with a demo of review, settings, refunds and rate mismatch handling.

title: What's New in Shopify Connector: Troubleshoot export issues -skipped records page (2025)
summary: Shopify connector skipped records page in Business Central: shows records skipped during export to Shopify because they are invalid or likely to be rejected. The video demos opening the page from the sync notification, fixing a customer with a missing email, and the logging mode field that controls logging.

title: Use Page Regions to Present your Reports and Data in Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)
summary: Page regions in Advanced Spreadsheets (reporting app) for Business Central: defining regions, tabbed preview mode, one printed page per region, read-only sharing by the owner, and slicers that work on live data. Demonstrated by Erik Hougaard in a 5-minute video.

title: What's New: Financial Analytics (2024 release wave 2)
summary: Financial analytics additions in Business Central 2024 release wave 2: a Power BI finance app with 14 reports, 17 financial reporting templates (5 row, 12 column definitions), three fixed assets Excel reports, ad hoc fixed assets analysis, new documentation, and three demo data sets planned for the second minor release.

title: Control When People Can Post to the General Ledger
summary: Restricting general ledger posting dates in Business Central: company-wide Allow Posting From and Allow Posting To fields in General Ledger Setup, with per-user overrides on the User Setup page so selected people, such as accountants, can still post in a closed period.

title: What's New: Concurrent Inventory Posting (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Concurrent inventory posting in Business Central (BC25, 2025 release wave 1): a feature key lets multiple users post item ledger and value entries at once, using number sequences instead of table locking. Covers the item register number field, deferred automatic cost posting to GL, and developer guidance.

title: Introducing: Tenant Discovery Endpoint (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Tenant discovery endpoint for the Business Central admin center API, introduced in 2025 release wave 1. It returns the tenants an authenticating app can manage, so partners no longer need to keep their own tenant list. A Logic App demo shows it used to automate app updates.

title: What's Next: AL-Go for GitHub (2025 release wave 1)
summary: AL-Go for GitHub plans in the 2025 release wave 1 video: indirect templates, NuGet publishing of runtime packages, running tests on online environments (generally available), security updates, and a 2-3 year move away from BC Container Helper.

title: What's New: Cloud Migration Tooling (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Cloud migration tooling in the 2026 release wave 1: a platform for developers to build custom migration tools, a Business Central version 14 re-implementation tool, and no-code migration from any SQL source using table mappings. Includes demos of the BC14 tool and no-code setup.

title: What's New: Value Chain Automation with Production Orders (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Value chain tracking for sustainability in Business Central production orders, in preview in 2025 release wave 1. It covers sustainability value entries, emissions on items, work centers, BOMs, routings and production journals. Only the average costing method and carbon equivalent are supported.

title: Use Data from a Report inside your Spreadsheet with Business Central  (Advanced Spreadsheets)
summary: Embedding report data in a spreadsheet with the Advanced Spreadsheets and reporting app for Business Central. Shows a report region (report 111 customer top 10), a donut chart built from it, live recalculation and filtering. Query regions are also mentioned.

title: What's New: Power BI for Projects and Inventory (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Power BI updates for Business Central inventory and projects in 2025 release wave 2: a new Inventory Forecasting report using statistical machine learning with seasonality settings, and an open source Project Power BI app with more focus on project profitability, shown with demos of sales by type and by customer.

title: What's New: Manufacturing Analytics (Updated Power BI App) Electronic Documents(2025 release wave 1)
summary: Updated Manufacturing Power BI app in Business Central 2025 release wave 1: reworked Work Center Load, Expected Capacity Need and Finished Production Order Breakdown reports, new Work Center and Machine Center statistics reports, a routing lines Gantt chart, and planned hiding of two utilization reports in version 26.1.

title: Expense Agent: Feedback (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Expense Agent feedback options in Business Central (2026 release wave 1): in-product positive feedback, suggestions and issue reports, contextual feedback on individual expenses, screenshots with manual redaction, support information, and optional contact details.

title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Storing Document Attachments outside the Database
summary: Offloading Business Central document attachments to external storage (blob storage, file share, SharePoint): setup with external file accounts and file scenarios, upload and delete policies, nightly job queue, and the backup risk the customer takes on.

title: What's New: Co-Development Initiative (2024 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central co-development initiative in 2024 release wave 2: 156 community contributions shipped. Five demos cover Manual Setup page cleanup, a duplicate external document notification, default GL account quantities, Copilot-assisted number series setup, and a ship-to phone number field.

title: What's New: Product Information Management in Shopify Connector (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Product information management changes in the Business Central Shopify connector (2026 release wave 1): variant image export, item attributes as Shopify options, collections and tax override, adding items as Shopify variants, and importing images and marketing text from Shopify.

title: Comparing Entering Customer Cash Receipts in Dynamics SL to Dynamics 365 Business Central
summary: Entering customer cash receipts in Dynamics SL compared with Business Central, which offers two ways to record customer payments: the Cash Receipts Journal and the Customer Register Payments window. Covers applying payments to invoices and posting. Aimed at users moving from Dynamics SL.

title: What's New: Business Central Integration with Power Platform including Power BI(2024 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2024 release wave 2 integration with Power Platform: Power Automate (linked environments, Find One Record and Find Records actions, job queue event, new designer), Copilot Studio connector with a demo, and Power BI (preview apps with 60+ report pages, embedding, multilanguage, connector options).

title: How Business Central Integrates with Microsoft Excel (2025)
summary: Business Central's Excel integration: exporting list page data, opening or editing it in Excel, building pivot tables and charts on refreshable data, and publishing bulk edits back through the Excel add-in pane. Demoed in a 3-minute video published 2025-05-22.

title: #BCTalent Stories: Node4 Digital
summary: Node4 Digital's experience with the Business Central Talent program: a UK partner describes recruiting Business Central consultants through it, receiving more candidates than it needed, and getting new hires productive within two to three weeks.

title: How to Access All Features in Business Central (2025)
summary: Business Central role-based homepages (business manager, accountant, sales and relationships, project manager) and the ways to reach all features: the menu header, the search bar and Alt-key shortcuts. A 2-minute demo from May 2025.

title: Getting Started With Agents: Test Drive the Sales Order Agent (2025)
summary: Sales order agent test drive in Business Central: connecting a shared mailbox, activating the agent, sending a test quote request email, and the agent creating a sales quote. Also covers creating a contact for an unknown sender and managing email accounts.

title: What's New: Telemetry (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central telemetry changes released since May 2023 (2023 release wave 2): AI-assisted performance analysis in Power BI reports, better web service, job queue, email and feature module error telemetry, and upcoming signals for change lock and pending extensions. It also covers the Usage Analytics Power BI app, KQL documentation and alerting options.

title: What's New: Business Central AI Resources (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Business Central AI Resources in 2025 release wave 1: Microsoft-managed Azure OpenAI (GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini) for publishers in SaaS production, moving from private to public preview, with consumption-based direct billing being added. Covers content safety, data privacy, bring-your-own subscription, AL patterns and model deprecation.

title: What's New: Service Management Demo Data (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Service management demo data in the Contoso Coffee demo tool (2023 release wave 2): the tool gains a service management model and simpler configuration pages. The video walks through an ad hoc service order scenario and a service contract scenario with maintenance orders.

title: What's New: Contoso Demo Tool (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Contoso Demo Tool redesign in 2025 release wave 1: demo data moves from monolithic Rapid Start packages to modular, code-based codeunits with layers, translation files and dynamic historical data. Code is in a GitHub app extensions repository, and the video says it is already available as part of 25.3.

title: #BCTalent Stories: Olivia from Clients First at Directions NA 2024
summary: Olivia from Clients First describes her experience as a new hire in a ReSkill program for Business Central, recorded at Directions NA 2024. It is evidence for how a reskill program is structured, how it builds community, and what learning and networking look like for a junior consultant.

title: Understanding the Sign Up Context and Using it for Profiling Customers
summary: Business Central sign up context: a URI-encoded parameter in the sign up redirect URL that carries the sign up origin and custom JSON key-value pairs from a website profiler. It covers app ID, country code and EULA requirements for app provisioning, and how apps read the stored context.

title: Allow Over Receipts of Products
summary: Over receipt codes in Business Central let you receive more than ordered from vendors. Codes carry tolerance percentages, can be set on item cards and vendor cards, and the most restrictive setting wins. A default 10% code applies if nothing else is set.

title: Use FlowFields directly inside your Spreadsheet inside Business Central  (Advanced Spreadsheets)
summary: Using FlowFields directly in Business Central Advanced Spreadsheets: building a FlowField region for item sales, adding date range regions, referencing cells in filters, and connecting slicers. Demonstrated with item sales calculated per period.

title: #BCTalent: Because talent is not bought - it's made
summary: #BCTalent is a 2-minute Business Central channel video from November 2024 about building talent through training, coaching and community. It is evidence for the message that expertise is developed step by step, not hired in, and has no product feature content.

title: How partners responds to the #BCTalent initiative: Reskill
summary: Partner testimonial on the Microsoft Reskill program, part of the #BCTalent initiative, which combines recruiting, training, onboarding and mentoring of new candidates for the Business Central ecosystem. The partner says candidates became billable after 12 weeks and that doing this alone would cost more.

title: What's New: Cost Adjustment (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Business Central 2025 release wave 1 cost adjustment changes: iterative adjustment by period for high-volume items, item by item commit, forced adjustment with reprocessing of entries, automatic self-diagnostics, and a cost adjustment tracer tool. Iterative adjustment and the tracer are demoed.

title: What's New: Warehouse Management (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Warehouse Management changes in Business Central 2023 release wave 2: bin policy features and put-away templates for basic warehouse, picking by ranking in inventory picks, over-receipt in inventory put-away, and a nothing-to-handle troubleshooting window for directed pick and put-away.

title: What's New in AL: Easy Access to Source Code with Open In VS Code and GitHub Projects (2024)
summary: Open In VS Code action and Source Control Details section on the Business Central extension management page, which show the GitHub repo and commit ID of an extension built with AL-Go for GitHub and open its source in VS Code. Also covers exploring a page in VS Code from the page inspector.

title: Introducing: Self-Billing Invoices (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Self-billing invoices in Business Central (2026 release wave 1): the customer creates the purchase invoice on behalf of the vendor. Covers the vendor card agreement field, the posted self-billing invoice number series, report selection, and a demo. Electronic invoicing based on self-billing is planned for the next release.

title: The "Continue" Keyword Finally Comes to AL — 3 Practical Examples (BC 2025 Wave 1)
summary: The continue keyword in AL for loops (for, while, repeat): skips the current iteration and moves to the next without ending the loop. Covers the difference from break, with three code examples: even numbers, sales invoice lines with customer emails, and a Microsoft IRS forms extension.

title: #BCTalent and AI: A Partner’s Guide
summary: Partner-focused talk on AI skills in the Business Central ecosystem, published 2025-08-19. It argues partners need deeper technical AI knowledge, should train existing staff and domain professionals as AI power users, and should join the BC Talent Program. It gives opinion and approach, not product feature details.

title: #BCTalent and AI: A Learner’s Guide
summary: AI career guidance for Business Central consultants and developers, from the #BCTalent program talk with Dona Sarkar (published 2025-08-19). It covers Copilot item description generation, the BC Sales Agent, Copilot Studio connectivity, and an announced adaptive UX, plus the skills to build.

title: Microsoft presents: Tests, dependencies, runners and evals for BC applications
summary: Microsoft session on testing Business Central apps: propagated dependencies, test explorer support in AL, new test codeunit properties, internal visible to, AI test agents, and data-driven AI tests and evals. Also covers CI/CD test selection, MCP-based test execution and token consumption. Native data-driven tests are not yet in the product.

title: Getting Started With Agents: Billing Agents in Business Central - Configure "Pay as You Go" (2025)
summary: Configuring pay-as-you-go billing for Business Central agents: create an Azure resource group, set up a billing plan in Power Platform admin center, create a Dataverse environment and link it to Business Central, then monitor consumption and set Azure budgets.

title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Financial Report Scheduling
summary: Financial report scheduling in Business Central, an announced feature, is demoed: financial reports are sent on a recurring schedule as Excel and PDF to the report inbox and by email to chosen recipients. Covers the Schedules action, run date controls, custom filters and date filter formulas.

title: AppSource App Previews
summary: Installing preview versions of AppSource apps in Business Central: how publishers set a preview key in Partner Center and share an install URL, and how administrators install, update and monitor previews. Covers sandbox-only installation, the highest-version rule, breaking changes between previews, and telemetry.

title: What's New: Resource Governance for Business Central Online (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Resource governance in Business Central Online (2023 release wave 2): how consumption tracking, user-based operational limits and planned entitlement quotas work. It covers the planned changes to speed, concurrency and execution time limits for scheduled tasks and web service requests.

title: What's New: Manufacturing Analytics (New and Updated Reports) (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Manufacturing reports in Business Central 2025 release wave 1: six updated reports in version 26.2 with Word and Excel layouts, two new Excel reports (Production Cost Shares, Work/Machine Center Load), and the deprecation of seven legacy reports. Shows how the Production Order VIP report works with its layouts.

title: Let It Snow: How To Use Themable Layouts in Business Central (2024)
summary: Themeable layouts in Business Central, added in 2024 release wave 2, shown by building a snowflake-themed Sales Quote Word layout with a custom picture watermark, uploading it on the Report Layouts page and setting it as a seasonal default, without a developer.

title: From Code to Docs: Using GitHub Copilot to Automate Business Central Documentation
summary: Spec-driven AL development with GitHub Copilot for Business Central: a docs-to-code workflow using agents, skills and living documentation in a Git repo. The session demos user stories, specs, architecture decisions, change control notices, release notes and SharePoint sync via GitHub Actions.

title: What's New: Server and Database - A Faster Data Stack (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2023 release wave 2 server and database changes: table extensions move to a single companion table, cutting n-way joins to one and speeding reads, inserts, modifies and deletes. Also covers SetLoadFields guidance, the new read committed locking model, and upcoming removals.

title: #BCTalent Stories: Sandlapper
summary: Sandlapper, a boutique partner firm, describes how the BC Talent program and its cross skills component helped it reach Business Central certification and gain confidence in Great Plains (GP) to Business Central migration conversations. It is a one-minute partner testimonial.

title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Sneak Peek into New Financial Reporting Enhancements (part 1)
summary: Financial reporting enhancements announced for the Business Central 2025 release: an internal description field for report definitions, editable introductory and closing paragraphs, and a negative amount format option (parentheses). All three are demoed in a 5-minute part 1 video.

title: Business Central Under the Hood episode 2: The Inner Workings of The AL Compiler
summary: AL compiler internals and history, from the C/SIDE era to today: Roslyn-based design, partial compilation and LSP for Visual Studio Code, transpiling AL to C#, and the unsupported, undocumented state of the compiler API. Also covers prototype VS Code designers and AL Explorer.

title: What's New: Enhanced Analysis Mode (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Enhanced analysis mode in Business Central (2026 release wave 1): developers can package analysis views in AL apps via exported JSON files, page extensions and profile customizations. Also covers view descriptions as tooltips, read-only shipped views, and built-in views announced for 28.x.

title: How 3 Partners are Building Powerful Agents for Business Central
summary: Partner experiences building agents for Business Central with Copilot Studio and the Business Central MCP server. Examples are a payroll agent, a purchase order creation agent and a sales claim agent, plus a push for reusable agents built in Business Central rather than as black boxes.

title: Getting Started With Agent Testing: How to Write Agent Evals in AL (Part 2)
summary: Writing agent evals in AL for Business Central agents: YAML-driven, data-driven tests that follow the agent task flow (message arrival, agent run, output verification, multi-turn), using the agent test library and its built-in keywords. Covers suite setup, placeholders, logging and the library agent's public methods.

title: What's new in Page Scripting  (2026 release wave 2)
summary: Page scripting in Business Central (2026 release wave 2): the tool for recording and replaying user actions in the web client moves from preview to generally available. The video covers full localization, multi-row selection in grids, validation of message and error text, and agent-generated scripts.

title: What's New: Shopify Connector (2024 release wave 2) in 2 minutes
summary: Shopify connector changes in Business Central 2024 release wave 2: meta fields import/export, language translation sync, company catalog pricing and discounts, shipping fee mapping, payment method reconciliation, and posted sales invoice sync to Shopify. A 2-minute overview published 2024-12-17.

title: Expense Agent: Web App Experience (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Expense agent web app in Business Central (2026 release wave 1): employees use app.expenses.dynamics.com with only an Enter ID and no Business Central license. The demo shows receipt capture, automatic data extraction, categorization, itemization and compliance checking based on administrator settings.

title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Replace Permission Sets Upon Import
summary: Replace permission sets upon import is announced for the Business Central 2025 wave 2 release. The Import permission sets action can now overwrite existing permissions instead of merging them, by answering no at the update prompt. A short demo shows the result.

title: What's New: Using Power Pages with Business Central (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Power Pages on Business Central virtual tables in Dataverse, with multi-company support added in 2024 release wave 1. A Dataverse shared execution variable (BC Company ID), set by a custom plugin, overrides the global and user-specific company settings so each portal can target a different company.

title: What's New: Legislation and Localization (2023 release wave 2)
summary: Business Central 2023 release wave 2 legislation and localization updates: 23 new countries announced for the cloud (155 markets from December 2023), Swedish delocalization timeline, EU three-party trade and automatic account codes apps, Audit File Expert, Intrastat drop shipment, and report format region.

title: What's New: Draft Page for Electronic Invoices (2025 release wave 2)
summary: Draft page for electronic invoices in Business Central (2025 release wave 2), in preview: users review and edit incoming e-documents before posting. It covers line matching through item references, text-to-account mapping, historical lines and an AI fallback, and requires e-document service version 2.

title: Drive Sales with AI-Generated Product Descriptions in Business Central (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Copilot product description generation in Business Central (2024 release wave 1), shown in a 2-minute demo: image-based category suggestion, attribute and tone customization, and publishing the product to Shopify through the first-party connector.

title: What's New: Customer-Managed Encryption Key (2025 release wave 1)
summary: Customer-managed encryption key (CMK) for Business Central environment databases, using a key in the customer's own Azure Key Vault. The video demos the setup from Key Vault through Enterprise Policy to Power Platform admin center and lists the constraints: managed environment, purge protection, matching region, and copy/restore behavior.

title: What's New: Shopify Connector - Overview (2026 release wave 1)
summary: Shopify connector changes in Business Central 2026 release wave 1: variant images and attributes, collections import, separate product and price updates, unit cost sync, presentment currency, fulfillment limits removed, tax code field removed, and the Shopify API upgrade to the January 2026 version.

title: What's Cooking in Business Central: Financial Reporting Enhancements (part 2): Telemetry
summary: Telemetry events for Business Central financial reporting, viewed in Application Insights: creation of financial reports, row definitions and column definitions, with definition codes logged. Also mentions modification, deletion and report-run events. A disclaimer in the facts says preview, version 2025 release wave one.

title: In Preview: User Acceptance Testing with the Page Scripting Tool (2024 release wave 1)
summary: Page Scripting Tool in Business Central, in preview in 2024 release wave 1: recording and playing back user acceptance tests in the web client, with validation steps, YAML scripts, parameters and suites. Covers permissions, sharing, conditional steps and known limitations such as no pipeline execution.

title: Snapshot Debugging vs AL Profiler in Business Central — When to Use Each
summary: Snapshot debugging versus the AL profiler in Business Central: snapshot debugging is for investigating errors, including in production, and the AL profiler is for finding performance bottlenecks. The video demos both, plus the Performance Profiler and the Scheduled Profiler for other users' sessions.

title: Use an Agent to SQL Query data inside your Spreadsheet with Business Central (Advanced Spreadsheets)
summary: Advanced Spreadsheets and Reporting app for Business Central: a demo of an AI agent that writes SQL regions in a spreadsheet, joining posted sales invoices with customer and ledger entries. Also shows manual SQL region creation. The app is stated to be free in the cloud sandbox.

title: Comparing Subaccounts Segments and Dimensions Transaction and Reporting Dynamics SL and Dynamics
summary: Dynamics SL subaccount segments compared with Business Central dimensions: segments migrate as dimensions via the cloud migration tool. The video demos default dimensions on vendors, automatic defaulting on purchase invoices, posting preview, and the Trial Balance Dimension Report.

title: What's New: Item Substitution with Copilot (2024 release wave 2)
